categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: tinplate packaging products, plastic packaging (including filling) products, and aluminum packaging (including filling) products. Tinplate products include tinplate base sheets, cold-rolled steel sheets, tinplate, printed tinplate, cans, and square barrels. Plastic packaging covers PET bottle caps, preforms, and beverage filling services, while aluminum packaging focuses on new aluminum bottle cans (NBC) and related filling services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced cold rolling and tin plating technologies for tinplate production, including acid pickling and continuous annealing lines. For plastic packaging, it employs PET molding and aseptic filling technologies. The aluminum packaging segment uses dry forming technology for aluminum cans, with patented processes ensuring food safety and environmental compliance. The company also integrates quality management systems like ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000, HACCP, and HALAL certification to ensure product quality and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include food and beverage manufacturers, chemical product companies, and electronics industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying packaging materials for canned foods, beverages, edible oils, paints, resins, inks, and various consumer goods. Major customers include subsidiaries of the Uni-President Group and other large beverage and food brands in Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and Mainland China, with production bases and subsidiaries in regions such as Jiangsu, Fujian, Sichuan, Guangdong, and Beijing. It also has operations in Vietnam and other Southeast Asian countries. Sales are distributed approximately 63% in China and 37% outside China, with significant export activities to global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the supply chain, including upstream production of tinplate base sheets, midstream manufacturing of tinplate and plastic packaging materials, and downstream filling and packaging services for beverages. It maintains a vertically integrated supply chain from raw steel coils to finished packaging products and filled beverages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening supply chain resilience, developing high value-added products, and expanding aseptic and carbonated beverage filling capabilities. R&D focuses on thin gauge steel production, low-carbon steel products, energy efficiency, and sustainable packaging materials like recyclable tinplate and aluminum. The company also invests in renewable energy systems and continuous process optimization to enhance sustainability and product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of packaging materials such as tinplate sheets, plastic bottles and caps, aluminum cans, and related filling services. The company also earns income from contract manufacturing and beverage filling services. Additional revenue streams include rental income from leased properties and financial income from investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading tinplate producer in Taiwan and a major player in Asia, holding about 72% market share in Taiwan's tinplate market and approximately 5% in Mainland China. It competes with large international steel and packaging companies, leveraging its technological advantages, vertical integration, and group resources. Its unique position as the sole tinplate base sheet producer in Taiwan provides high entry barriers against competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$44.86 billion, a 27.3% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company rising 125% to NT$1.53 billion. Total assets reached about NT$34.92 billion, with equity of NT$21.71 billion. The company shows a stable growth trajectory supported by increased sales volume and improved profit margins across its product segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly packaging solutions with strong technical capabilities in tinplate production and aseptic filling technologies. It offers integrated services from raw material supply to finished product filling, ensuring product safety and compliance with international standards such as ISO and HALAL. Its scale, technological leadership, and group affiliation provide customers with reliable supply, innovative products, and comprehensive support.
